skills.name: pdf
skills.summary: Process PDF files - extract text, create PDFs, merge documents. Use when user asks to read PDF, create PDF, or work with PDF files.

en.purpose: Enables the agent to extract text, create, merge, and split PDF files using command-line tools and Python libraries.
scenarios: Extracting plain text or metadata from an existing PDF document
Converting Markdown or HTML files into styled PDF documents
Merging multiple PDF documents or splitting a PDF into individual pages
en.io: Inputs PDF, Markdown, or HTML files, and outputs extracted text, metadata, or newly created PDF files.
en.boundary: Does not support advanced interactive PDF form filling, complex dynamic layout editing, or built-in OCR processing without external Tesseract setup.

zh.purpose: 使 Agent 能够利用命令行工具和 Python 库对 PDF 文件进行文本提取、生成、合并和拆分等处理。
scenarios: 从现有 PDF 文档中提取纯文本或元数据信息
将 Markdown 或 HTML 文件转换为排版好的 PDF 文档
合并多个 PDF 文档或将单份 PDF 拆分为单页文件
zh.io: 输入 PDF、Markdown 或 HTML 文件，输出提取的文本、元数据或新生成的 PDF 文件。
zh.boundary: 不支持高级交互式 PDF 表单填写、复杂的动态可视化编辑，也不在未额外配置 Tesseract 时直接提供扫描件 OCR 识别。

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.summary: Build MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give Claude new capabilities. Use when user wants to create an MCP server, add tools to Claude, or integrate external services.

en.purpose: Guides the development and configuration of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Python or TypeScript to extend Claude's capabilities with external tools and data sources.
scenarios: Building a custom Python or TypeScript MCP server from scratch
Wrapping external REST APIs or databases into tool interfaces accessible by Claude
Generating configuration snippets to register new MCP servers into Claude's configuration (`mcp.json`)
en.io: Accepts requirements for custom tools, APIs, or data integrations, and outputs functional MCP server implementation code along with configuration files.
en.boundary: Focuses on generating and configuring MCP server code, but does not manage long-term server deployment, hosting on cloud infrastructure, or dynamic runtime execution.

zh.purpose: 指导使用 Python 或 TypeScript 开发和配置自定义 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 服务端，以扩展 Claude 的外部工具和数据集成能力。
scenarios: 从零构建 Python 或 TypeScript 版的 MCP 服务端代码
将外部 REST API 或数据库封装为可供 Claude 调用的 MCP 工具
生成将新 MCP 服务端注册到 Claude 环境所需的配置文件（如 `mcp.json`）
zh.io: 输入关于工具、API 或数据库集成的开发需求，输出可执行的 MCP 服务端源代码及相关配置文件。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于生成和配置 MCP 服务端代码，不负责将服务端部署到云端生产环境或进行长期的运行维护。

skills.name: code-review
skills.summary: Perform thorough code reviews with security, performance, and maintainability analysis. Use when user asks to review code, check for bugs, or audit a codebase.

en.purpose: Performs comprehensive code reviews focusing on security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, code correctness, and maintainability.
scenarios: Auditing a Pull Request or git diff before merging code changes.
Scanning source code for security flaws like SQL injection or hardcoded secrets.
Reviewing existing codebases for performance bottlenecks and refactoring opportunities.
en.io: Accepts source code files, diffs, or repository paths as input and outputs a structured markdown review report detailing critical issues, recommendations, and a merge verdict.
en.boundary: It provides review analysis and actionable suggestions, but does not automatically modify source code, execute full build pipelines, or fix identified issues autonomously.

zh.purpose: 针对代码库或变更开展涵盖安全性、正确性、性能及可维护性的结构化代码审查。
scenarios: 在合并代码前对 Pull Request 或 Git diff 进行全面的 Bug 和安全审计。
扫描源代码中是否存在 SQL 注入、硬编码密钥等常见安全漏洞。
评估现有代码库的性能瓶颈并提供重构与改进建议。
zh.io: 输入源代码片段、Diff 变更或文件路径，输出包含问题分类、修复建议及合并判定结论的 Markdown 审查报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅提供代码评审与改进建议，不会自动修改源代码、执行完整构建流水线或直接修复代码缺陷。

en.purpose: Guides users in designing and building AI agents across various domains using a minimalist, model-first architectural approach.
scenarios: Designing a custom AI agent architecture for business, research, or operational tasks
Selecting core capabilities, knowledge structures, and context management strategies for a new assistant
Simplifying and refactoring over-engineered agentic workflows and subagent patterns
en.io: Takes user requirements, domain concepts, or architectural questions as input, and outputs agent design specifications, capability breakdowns, and implementation guidance.
en.boundary: It provides architectural concepts, design patterns, and strategic guidance for building agents, but does not execute agent deployments or directly manage live infrastructure.

zh.purpose: 指导用户以“模型驱动、精简设计”的核心理念，设计与构建适用于各种领域的 AI Agent 系统。
scenarios: 为业务、科研或运营自动化任务设计定制化的 AI Agent 架构
为新助手规划核心能力组件、知识库载入方式与上下文管理策略
简化与重构过于复杂的 Agent 工作流或子 Agent 协作机制
zh.io: 输入用户的业务需求、应用场景或架构疑问，输出 Agent 的设计规范、能力拆解及实现指导建议。
zh.boundary: 本技能专注于 Agent 的架构设计理念与能力规划，不直接进行生产环境的代码部署或线上基础设施运维。

skills.name: work-status
skills.summary: Shows WORK progress and TASK status. Use when the user asks about WORK list, WORK progress, TASK status, or pipeline status (e.g., "WORK list", "WORK-01 progress", "show status").

en.purpose: Checks and reports the current progress and status of project WORKs and TASKs by reading tracking files.
scenarios: Checking the overall progress list of all active WORKs in a project
Viewing detailed TASK-level progress for a specific WORK (e.g., WORK-01)
Checking the completion details and results of a specific TASK
en.io: Input: Query arguments or WORK/TASK identifiers; Output: A formatted status summary detailing completed, in-progress, and pending tasks.
en.boundary: This skill only reads file statuses and reports information; it does not create, modify, execute, or archive any WORKs or TASKs.

zh.purpose: 通过读取跟踪文件，检查并汇报项目 WORK 和 TASK 的当前进度与状态。
scenarios: 查看项目中所有活动 WORK 的整体进度列表
查询特定 WORK（例如 WORK-01）的具体 TASK 级执行进度
查看某个特定 TASK 的完成详情与结果
zh.io: 输入：查询参数或 WORK/TASK 标识符；输出：展示已完成、进行中和未开始任务的格式化状态摘要报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅用于读取文件状态并汇报信息，不会创建、修改、执行或归档任何 WORK 或 TASK。

skills.name: work-pipeline
skills.summary: Triggers the WORK-PIPELINE when a user request starts with a [] tag (e.g., [new-feature], [bugfix], [WORK start]). Use this skill whenever you detect a [] tag at the beginning of a user message.

en.purpose: Orchestrates multi-agent software development workflows whenever a user request begins with a bracketed tag.
scenarios: Initiating structured feature development or bug fixes using tags like [new-feature] or [bugfix].
Running fully automated software pipelines from specification to commit without approval gates using the 'auto' flag.
Managing approval checkpoints and delegating execution steps across specialized sub-agents.
en.io: Takes user messages prefixed with bracketed tags as input and triggers sequential sub-agent executions while generating work artifact files.
en.boundary: It acts solely as a workflow orchestrator and trigger mechanism, leaving actual requirement analysis, code writing, verification, and committing to downstream sub-agents.

zh.purpose: 当用户消息以方括号标签开头时，自动触发并编排多 Agent 软件开发流水线。
scenarios: 使用如 [new-feature] 或 [bugfix] 等标签启动结构化的新功能开发或缺陷修复流程。
通过在指令末尾添加 'auto' 标记，跳过人工审批阶段以执行全自动开发流水线。
管理多阶段 Agent 协作中的人工审批关卡与子 Agent 任务调度。
zh.io: 接收以方括号标签开头的用户需求作为输入，输出结构化工作文档（如 Requirement.md）并按顺序调度各阶段子 Agent 运行。
zh.boundary: 仅负责流水线触发、路径传递与审批关卡编排，不直接执行具体的代码编写、测试验证或 Git 提交。

skills.name: uctm-init
skills.summary: Initialize uc-taskmanager for the current project. Creates works/ directory and configures Bash permissions in .claude/settings.local.json. Use when the user says "uctm init", "initialize uctm", "uctm 초기화", or "초기화".

en.purpose: Initializes the current project for uc-taskmanager execution by creating the required directory structure and setting up local permissions.
scenarios: Setting up a new project workspace for uc-taskmanager workflows.
Configuring pre-approved local Bash permissions in Claude settings.
Preparing workspace directories before running task pipelines.
en.io: Inputs: User confirmation and initialization prompt; Outputs: Created 'works/' directory, updated '.claude/settings.local.json', and execution summary.
en.boundary: This skill only performs project initialization and permission configuration, without executing pipelines or generating feature code.

zh.purpose: 通过创建必需的目录结构和配置本地 Bash 权限，为当前项目初始化 uc-taskmanager 环境。
scenarios: 在新项目中首次搭建 uc-taskmanager 工作流环境。
自动在 Claude 本地设置中配置预授权的 Bash 命令权限。
在运行任务 Pipeline 前准备基础工作空间目录。
zh.io: 输入：用户的初始化指令及确认许可；输出：创建的 'works/' 目录、更新后的 '.claude/settings.local.json' 文件和状态报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责项目环境初始化和权限配置，不涉及具体的任务 Pipeline 执行或业务代码编写。

skills.name: security-audit
skills.summary: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

en.purpose: Performs a deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, secrets scanning, and dependency vulnerabilities by delegating to the Centinela QA agent.
scenarios: Verifying security posture prior to a software release
Auditing code changes affecting authentication, authorization, or sensitive data handling
Scanning the codebase for hardcoded secrets and vulnerable package dependencies
Checking Solidity smart contracts for common security flaws like reentrancy
en.io: Accepts optional target file or directory paths and outputs a detailed Markdown security audit report containing severity-ranked findings and a verdict.
en.boundary: Identifies and documents security vulnerabilities with verdict recommendations, but never automatically modifies or fixes the code.

zh.purpose: 通过委派 Centinela (QA) 智能体，执行涵盖 OWASP Top 10、身份验证、密钥扫描及依赖漏洞的深度安全审计。
scenarios: 软件版本发布前的代码安全状态验证
审计涉及身份验证、授权或敏感数据处理的代码变更
扫描代码库中的硬编码密钥以及存在已知 CVE 的依赖包
检查 Solidity 智能合约是否存在重入等常见安全漏洞
zh.io: 接受可选的待审计文件或目录路径作为输入，输出包含漏洞分级和最终评估结论的 Markdown 格式安全审计报告。
zh.boundary: 仅负责发现并记录安全漏洞并给出评估结论，绝不会尝试自动修改或修复任何代码。

en.purpose: Provides internal schemas, flow definitions, and rule reference documents for automated software development (SDD) pipeline agents.
scenarios: Guiding pipeline agents (specifier, planner, builder, etc.) on standardized workflow procedures.
Formatting inter-agent XML communications, activity logs, and file schemas.
Enforcing context sliding window policies during long-running automated tasks.
en.io: Inputs are agent schema lookup requests or workflow queries; outputs are structural rules, prompt conventions, and XML/file formatting schemas.
en.boundary: Does not execute tasks or directly interact with end users, functioning solely as an internal static reference repository for autonomous pipeline agents.

zh.purpose: 为多 Agent 软件开发（SDD）流水线中的内部 Agent 提供规范 Schema、流程定义及上下文策略参考文件。
scenarios: 指导流水线 Agent（如 specifier、planner、builder 等）遵循统一的工作流规范
规范 Agent 间的 XML 通信格式、活动日志（Activity Log）及文件结构
在长程自动化任务中约束滑动窗口上下文管理策略
zh.io: 输入为 Agent 的 Schema 查询或流程规则调取请求，输出为结构化规则、Prompt 范式及文件格式规范。
zh.boundary: 不直接响应用户指令或执行具体代码构建任务，仅作为流水线内部 Agent 调用的静态规则参考。

skills.name: review-findings
skills.summary: Addresses and fixes findings from a QA code review. Reads the review report, fixes critical and warning issues, and prepares for re-verification. Delegates to the Forja (Dev) agent.

en.purpose: Addresses and fixes critical and warning issues identified in a QA code review report by delegating execution to the Forja development agent.
scenarios: Fixing critical and warning issues found during a QA code review
Updating unit tests and removing dead code based on review findings
Generating a detailed fix report to prepare for QA re-verification
en.io: Takes a QA review report file path (or defaults to the latest report) as input, and outputs updated source code, passing tests, and a fix report.
en.boundary: Does not perform the QA code review or re-verification itself, and only fixes issues that are documented in a review report.

zh.purpose: 读取 QA 代码审查报告并将修复任务委托给 Forja 开发 Agent，以解决 Critical 和 Warning 级别的问题并准备重新验证。
scenarios: 修复 QA 代码审查后发现的高优先级缺陷与警告问题
根据审查反馈补充/更新测试用例并清理死代码
生成修复报告，记录变更及推迟处理警告的理由，供 QA 重新验证
zh.io: 输入 QA 审查报告文件路径（未指定时默认使用最新报告），输出修复后的代码、测试用例以及修复报告。
zh.boundary: 本技能本身不执行 QA 代码审查或重新验证流程，也不处理无对应审查报告的自由修补任务。

skills.name: release-check
skills.summary: Pre-release verification checklist. Validates features, tests, docs, security, and quality gates before shipping. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

en.purpose: Runs a comprehensive pre-release verification checklist covering documentation, quality gates, and security to issue a final release verdict.
scenarios: Verifying release readiness before deploying a new version to production.
Running quality and security checks before tagging a Git release.
Serving as a final quality gate after completing all features and code reviews.
en.io: Accepts a target release version string as input and outputs a markdown assessment report along with a final verdict (READY FOR RELEASE or BLOCKED).
en.boundary: It evaluates pre-release checks and generates reports, but does not automatically resolve code flaws or handle actual deployment execution.

zh.purpose: 在发布前执行涵盖文档、代码质量与安全把关的综合核查清单，并给出最终的发布判定。
scenarios: 在将新版本部署到生产环境之前进行发布就绪状态核验。
在给代码打 Git 版本标签前执行最终的质量与安全检查。
在完成所有功能开发与代码审查后作为最终的质量关卡。
zh.io: 输入目标发布版本号字符串，输出位于 `docs/reviews/` 的 Markdown 评估报告及最终结论（可发布或阻塞）。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅进行预发布评估与报告生成，不会自动修复发现的代码缺陷或直接执行部署上线。

skills.name: open
skills.summary: Boot the session, load context from the vault, and surface what matters

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Edit(**/vault/**), Edit(**/memory/**), Write(**/

en.purpose: Boots a session by verifying vault integrity, recovering unbanked session state, and loading key context and active priorities into memory.
scenarios: Starting a routine work session to load recent context and active priorities
Recovering session summaries after an unclean shutdown or crash
Surfacing stale delegation items and aging decisions at startup
en.io: Inputs vault notes, memory logs, and environment configurations, and outputs prioritized session context, state updates, and surfaced alerts.
en.boundary: It only boots sessions and surfaces vault context, without performing environment setup, initial system configuration, or direct task execution.

zh.purpose: 通过验证 Vault 结构完整性、恢复上次未正常结束的会话，并加载关键上下文与优先级来启动工作会话。
scenarios: 启动日常工作会话以加载最近的上下文和当前优先级
在未正常关闭后自动恢复上一次会话的摘要信息
在启动时检查停滞的委托事项和待复核的决策
zh.io: 输入 Vault 笔记、内存日志与环境变量配置，输出优先级化的会话上下文、状态更新和待办事项提醒。
zh.boundary: 它仅负责会话启动和上下文调取，不进行环境安装配置、首次系统初始化或具体的任务深度执行。

skills.name: implement-feature
skills.summary: Implements a feature from its specification. Reads the spec, designs architecture, writes code and tests. Delegates to the Forja (Dev) agent.

en.purpose: Executes the end-to-end implementation of an approved feature specification by orchestrating architecture design, code creation, testing, and QA handoff through the Forja agent.
scenarios: Implementing code and tests directly from a finalized feature spec file
Generating source files and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for a complex module
Preparing structured implementation artifacts and handoff notes for QA verification
en.io: Takes a feature name or specification file path as input and outputs implemented source code, unit and integration tests, architecture records, and QA handoff notes.
en.boundary: This skill does not create initial product requirements/specs nor perform final QA testing, requiring a pre-approved specification and delegating verification to a QA agent.

zh.purpose: 通过委托 Forja 开发 Agent 进行架构设计、代码编写、测试和 QA 交付，根据已批准的功能规范实现完整的软件功能。
scenarios: 根据已确定的功能规范文档开发新功能模块
为复杂功能生成源代码、自动化测试以及架构决策记录（ADR）
整理并准备已完成的代码实现与交付说明，以便移交给 QA Agent
zh.io: 输入功能名称或规范文件路径，输出实现的代码、单元与集成测试、架构决策记录以及 QA 交付说明文档。
zh.boundary: 该技能不负责编写初始产品需求规范或执行最终 QA 测试，必须依赖事先批准的规范并将后续验证委托给 QA Agent。

skills.name: feature-spec
skills.summary: Creates a complete product feature specification with acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, and risks. Delegates to the Prometeo (PM) agent.

en.purpose: Creates a complete product feature specification file with acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, and risks by delegating tasks to the Prometeo PM agent.
scenarios: Defining user stories and GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria for a new feature
Documenting business requirements and risks before starting software development
Preparing structured feature specification handoffs for developer agents
en.io: Takes a feature description prompt as input and generates a complete Markdown specification file at docs/specs/{feature-name}.md.
en.boundary: Generates feature specs and handoff documentation, but does not write code or implement the feature directly.

zh.purpose: 通过委派给 Prometeo (PM) Agent，自动生成包含用户故事、验收标准、范围及风险的完整产品功能需求规范文档。
scenarios: 在开发新功能前定义用户故事与 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 验收标准
在编码实施前梳理业务需求、依赖项及潜在风险
生成结构化的需求规格文档并准备向 Dev Agent 进行交接
zh.io: 输入功能描述指令，在 docs/specs/{feature-name}.md 输出完整的 Markdown 格式需求规格说明文件。
zh.boundary: 仅负责编写功能规格文档与开发交接说明，不直接进行任何代码编写或实际功能开发。

skills.name: code-health
skills.summary: Scans the codebase for dead code, tech debt, outdated dependencies, and code quality issues. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

en.purpose: Scans the codebase for dead code, technical debt, outdated dependencies, and quality issues by delegating tasks to the Centinela (QA) agent.
scenarios: Performing periodic codebase hygiene checks and maintenance audits
Verifying code cleanliness and unresolved technical debt prior to a product release
Checking for code smells and unused assets after a major code refactoring
Assessing current codebase quality and technical debt when onboarding to a new project
en.io: Takes a codebase scan command as input and outputs a detailed, prioritized Markdown audit report saved at docs/reviews/code-health-{date}.md.
en.boundary: It only detects and documents code quality issues in a report, and does not automatically refactor or fix the identified code.

zh.purpose: 通过委派任务给 Centinela (QA) 智能体，全面扫描代码库中的废弃代码、技术债务、过期依赖项及代码质量问题。
scenarios: 进行定期的代码库卫生检查与日常维护审计
在产品发布前确认代码干净程度并排查未解决的技术债务
在完成大规模代码重构后检查代码异味与未使用的资源
在新人员入职时评估当前代码库的技术债务与质量状况
zh.io: 输入为代码库扫描指令，输出为保存在 docs/reviews/code-health-{date}.md 的优先级 Markdown 审查报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责检测并记录代码健康问题，不会自动对代码进行重构或修复。

skills.name: close
skills.summary: Commit the session to durable vault memory and prepare a clean resume point

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Edit(**/vault/**), Write(**/vault/**), Wri

en.purpose: Commits current session context, logs, and discipline audits to durable vault memory while preparing a clean resume point.
scenarios: Ending an agent session cleanly to persist operational memory and audit ledgers.
Recording honesty checks, trust-decay claims, and failure modes before session shutdown.
Validating the aigent-OS vault layout before applying any durable state mutations.
en.io: Accepts active session state and vault configurations as inputs, and outputs updated ledger files and session resume points to the vault directory.
en.boundary: It does not perform tasks outside of session wrap-up or write files outside the validated vault root directory.

zh.purpose: 将当前会话上下文、日志及纪律审计记录提交至持久化 Vault 存储，并准备干净的会话恢复点。
scenarios: 在智能体会话结束时干净地持久化运行记忆与审计日志。
在会话关闭前记录诚信检查、信任衰减声明及失效模式。
在执行持久化状态修改前验证 aigent-OS Vault 目录结构的有效性。
zh.io: 输入当前活跃会话状态与 Vault 配置，向 Vault 目录输出更新后的日志文件与会话恢复点。
zh.boundary: 它不处理会话收尾与记忆提交之外的任务，也不会在经过验证的 Vault 根目录之外写入任何文件。

skills.name: airtable-automation

en.boundary: It does not produce neutral market research briefings, nor does it expose private user context to external search tools during collection phases.

zh.purpose: 对对标的标杆对象开展对抗性尽职调查，剔除营销泡沫并提取真实成功因素，最终将其转化为针对使用者自身资源的定制化行动方案。
scenarios: 拆解竞品或KOL的真实增长路径，剖析其成功究竟源于真本事还是运气与时机
核实并揭露虚高的市场宣称，如夸大的用户增长、估值或排名数据
结合使用者自身的私密资源与局限，将经过验证的标杆打法直接映射转化为具体行动策略
zh.io: 输入标杆对象信息及可选的使用者私密资源背景，输出一份包含真伪打假、成因拆解及个性化行动路线的尽调报告。
zh.boundary: 本技能不提供中立客观的综合市场简报，且在数据采集与验证阶段严禁将使用者的私密资源信息泄露至外部搜索中。

en.purpose: Diagnoses, repairs, and standardizes local repository development environments and Git workflows safely for Claude Code or Codex.

Auditing and configuring AI agent startup lifecycle hooks and project instructions
Safely performing Git synchronization, conflict resolution, or history cleanup without losing local work
Standardizing repository onboarding documentation and handoff guides for team collaborators
en.io: Accepts an optional repository path or natural-language setup request and produces environment diagnostic reports, updated configuration files, or executed Git operations.
en.boundary: It does not automatically force-overwrite, stash, rebase, or discard uncommitted local changes to make setup appear successful without explicit user permission.

zh.purpose: 为 Claude Code 或 Codex 诊断、修复并规范化本地代码库开发环境配置及安全的 Git 工作流。

诊断与配置 AI Agent 的启动 Hook 生命周期及项目指令规范
安全地进行 Git 同步、冲突解决或代码历史清理，避免丢失本地工作
规范和完善团队协作时的代码库 Onboarding 交付流程与文档
zh.io: 接收可选的代码库路径或自然语言设置请求，输出环境诊断报告、修复后的配置文件或执行完毕的安全 Git 操作指令。

en.purpose: Transcribes audio and video files into speaker-labeled text while offering built-in audio preprocessing tools for ASR pipelines.

Preprocessing multi-segment recorder dumps into 16kHz mono audio for ASR readiness.
Compressing and speeding up long audio files to reduce remote ASR API transcription costs.

zh.purpose: 将音视频文件转录为带说话人标签的文本，并提供专为 ASR 流程设计的音频预处理功能。

将录音笔的多段音视频文件合并并重采样为适合 ASR 处理的 16kHz 单声道音频。
对长音频进行压缩与倍速预处理，以降低远程 ASR API 的计费成本。

en.purpose: Evaluates AI systems and organizational readiness against the EU AI Act to classify risk levels and identify compliance gaps.

Conducting compliance gap analyses for high-risk AI deployments within an organization.
Generating actionable compliance roadmaps and technical documentation checklists.

zh.boundary: 仅提供合规参考指导与差距分析，不提供具有法律约束力的法律咨询或官方机构认证。

skills.summary: Rigorous, defensible email-spoofability verdict and SPF supply-chain risk analysis computed from published DNS alone. Deepens the record-level SPF/DMARC/DKIM/BIMI/MTA-STS/DNSSEC fetch recipes in the offensive-osint arsenal (§16.14) with the reasoning that section doesn't do: a priority-ordered composite verdict for whether an attacker can actually land header-From-spoofed mail in an inbox, and by which vector (exact-domain vs subdomain) — grounded in the single most-misunderstood distinction in email security: the envelope MAIL FROM that SPF authenticates vs the visible header From: that only DMARC governs. Explains precisely why SPF -all/~all alone is NOT spoof-proof without DMARC enforcement, and why SPF +all bypasses DMARC even under p=reject pct=100. Covers RFC 7208 §4.6.4's 10-DNS-lookup / 2-void-lookup PermError fail-open condition with a runnable stdlib-only lookup-counter script, plus the SPF-include-takeover supply-chain vector (an attacker re-registering a dead include inherits SPF-pass authority over the victim domain) with strict transient-vs-NXDOMAIN discrimination discipline so a temporary SERVFAIL is never mistaken for a takeover lead. Fully passive: DNS TXT reads only, no mail sent, no RCPT TO probe, no API keys. Use when auditing a domain's real spoofing resistance (not just its published records), explaining to a client why 'we have SPF -all' does not mean they're covered, investigating an SPF PermError or an unusually long include chain, evaluating a dead SPF include as a takeover lead, or writing a defensible spoofability finding for a deliverable.

en.purpose: Evaluates email domain spoofability and SPF supply-chain risks based purely on passive DNS record analysis.
scenarios: Auditing whether an attacker can land spoofed header-From emails for a target domain
Investigating SPF PermError 10-lookup limits and void lookup thresholds
Identifying dead SPF includes to detect supply-chain takeover vulnerabilities
Explaining why an SPF -all record without DMARC enforcement fails to prevent email spoofing
en.io: Accepts raw DNS TXT records for email authentication protocols and outputs a structured spoofability verdict with supply-chain risk findings.
en.boundary: It performs passive DNS analysis only and does not send test emails, perform SMTP RCPT TO probes, or audit TLS and certificate security.

Use when you've identified a 'check then act' pattern in code, when fuzzing for race conditions, or when exploiting concurrency bugs in privileged binaries / kernel / orchestrators.

en.purpose: This skill provides a structured methodology and reference guide for identifying, analyzing, and exploiting Time-of-Check / Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerabilities across local, kernel, container, and web environments.
scenarios: Auditing applications and system services for unsafe file path or permission checks.
Analyzing race condition attack vectors in container runtimes, kernels, or orchestrators during security assessments.
